Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. GuardWorks is doing a routine security and procurement review for our cloud stack partners — I was asked to collect CAIQ responses and representative evidence so our GRC team can triage. Attached is our CAIQ template (CSV) with a handful of clarifying columns; if you can send a mapping of Redwood answers plus at least one representative artifact per control that would be ideal.

Key asks:
- Completed CAIQ CSV with a short rationale per control
- Evidence or artifact per claim (PDF or presigned S3 links)
- Owner for each control we can ping during the review window (next two weeks)

Can your team get an initial draft by EOD Friday (2026-09-24)? If not, a short timeline would help us prioritize.

Attachments: guardworks-caiq-template.csv

Appreciate it — looking forward to working through this.

Best,

2) Kimberly (security eng) will map controls to owners and a shortlist of artifacts.
